copyChanges: Primary text as briefed: 156 characters; the offer ('BUY2: 10% off 2 pieces.') ends at character 122. Meta headline 38 (type, price, offer), description 23.

On-image card name: 'Serpentine Whisper Chain' instead of the brief's 'Serpentine Whisper Chain — Silver' (product field keeps the full listing name). The suffix printed 'SILVER' alone in caps, which RULINGS bars as the metal word, and the card line already says 'silver tone'; it also brought the Feed under the A6 text share.

Lint against RULINGS: no diamond, solitaire diamond, sterling, real or solid gold, freshwater, emerald or ruby; the metal only as 'silver tone' (and 'silver tone PVD' on the card, from the listing's 'PVD rhodium coating'); the stone only as cubic zirconia; no compare-at price (listing ₹1,499 not printed); no free shipping. 'Waterproof and tarnish-free' is allowed for this SKU (RULINGS §1.1; the listing carries all three claim tags) and sits as a proof line at the end of the primary text, not the headline; no water imagery. BUY2 10% on 2+ and BUY3 20% on 3+ match RULINGS §2 and the b04 pre-flight; two codes, so 'Codes'. Stock 23 (20+). Never shown or priced beside the gold version. The UTM landing URL is the only URL and carries no signature. Velista lines carry no digits, ₹, middle dots or dashes.
